Fuzzer for fd_lookup_ipliteral with IPv4 and IPv6 family checks.

# Purpose
This file defines a libFuzzer entry point for testing [`fd_lookup_ipliteral`](<#fd_lookup_ipliteral>), which parses an IP literal string into an `address` structure. [`LLVMFuzzerInitialize`](<#llvmfuzzerinitialize>) sets the log environment, starts the `fd` runtime with `fd_boot`, registers `fd_halt` with `atexit`, and lowers the core log level. [`LLVMFuzzerTestOneInput`](<#llvmfuzzertestoneinput>) reads fuzz data, selects an address family from the first byte, copies the remaining bytes into a null-terminated name buffer, and calls [`fd_lookup_ipliteral`](<#fd_lookup_ipliteral>) with that input. If the lookup succeeds, it checks that the returned address family is either `AF_INET` or `AF_INET6`.
